title: The blood-pressure widget reads its erase when the save is asked, not when the reading is typed
evidence: Found 2026-11-25 in PR 2081's review: widget-src/src/widgets/BloodPressure.tsx reads the shown erase when the save is asked. Carrying the erase per reading (typedOn) was tried and taken out: a reading still on screen from before an erase kept its old erase, so every later reading was refused silently.
